metadata.description: Returns rows in the draft version of the specified table.
metadata.learn_more: Returns rows in the draft version of the specified table. Row results can be filtered and sorted. Filtering and sorting options will be sent as query parameters to the API request. For example, by adding the query parameters `column1__gt=5&sort=-column1`, API returns the rows with values for column `column1` greater than 5 and in the descending order of `column1` values. Refer to the [overview section](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/cms/hubdb#filtering-and-sorting-table-rows) for detailed filtering and sorting options.

tableIdOrName.label: Table Id Or Name
tableIdOrName.description: The ID or name of the table to query.

after.label: After
after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Specifies whether to return archived rows. Defaults to `false`.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is `1000`.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: The number of rows to skip before starting to return results.

properties.label: Properties
properties.description: Specify the column names to get results containing only the required columns instead of all column details. If you want to include multiple columns in the result, use this query param as many times.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Specifies the column names to sort the results by.
